# Map

<!-- Generated by `npm run profiles`; edit scripts/profiles.ts or the guidance files, not this. -->

Measured on 500 of LC's maps. A field is **shown** when 50% or more of them have it, and **suggested** at 10% to 50%, unless an override says otherwise. An existing record also gets a row for every value it has, whatever its tier. [All kinds](README.md) · [The rules](../which-fields.md)

## Defined by

A record is a map when its Work's type is `Cartography`, and no kind above it in [the list](README.md) matches first. Choosing map for a new record writes: Instance type `Print`, Work type `Cartography`.

## Overrides

None: every tier here comes from the measured share.

## Available through Add field

Properties some of LC's maps have that the sections don't offer: under 10% of them, or moved here by an override. Add field offers these and every other BIBFRAME property, with their shares.

`bf:productionMethod` 6%, `bf:polarity` 5%, `bf:productionStatement` 5%, `bf:acquisitionSource` 5%, `bf:generation` 4%, `bf:manufactureStatement` 4%, `bf:copyrightDate` 3%, `bf:temporalCoverage` 2%, `bf:distributionStatement` 1%

## Never offered

Record-keeping and structure, whatever their share: `bf:adminMetadata`, `bf:instanceOf`, `bf:hasInstance`, `bflc:aap`, `bflc:aap-normalized`, `dcterms:isPartOf`.
